name: Bad Laasphe (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically white and black, charged in the upper part with the city arms of Bad Laasphe (a black castle on white).
history: Flag and banner were approved in January 1976; the flag is white and black in two equal stripes with the city arms at the centre, the banner with the arms in the middle of the upper half.

features.role: Bad Laasphe arms — black castle on white
